source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.0, data build 981, released 2026-10-14

data.summary: At the start of each battle round, choose up to two [Relics of the Matriarchs](vsdata:ability/adepta-sororitas.triumph-of-saint-katherine.relics-of-the-matriarchs). If selected, this option gives models in friendly **ADEPTA SORORITAS** units within 6″ of the Triumph **[Feel No Pain 6+](vsdata:core-rule/feel-no-pain)** until the next round starts.
